title: Complexes and Addiction
excerpt: A subpersonality feeding the ego, and the urgency it manufactures — chemically addicting, and disguised as a search for truth.

body: an identity (subpersonality/association-complex) relaying information to [or: strengthening associations between] my general identity (ego/foundational subpersonality/association-complex) as the awareness narrates (naturally from association).

the information relayed to my different association-complexes is so satisfying and gratifying. it becomes too sweet. 2 unfamiliar worlds merging. again, even if its the most scariest or happiest information. the drama. the absolute seriousness. the URGENCY it creates. is ADDICTING (literally chemically addicting). it feels like the only thing that matters, the only thing that exists. the only thing worth exploring and entertaining. thats why i went so far into an unknown nothingness.
this is part of what i mean when i say obsessed with truth.
and so, the cycle continues until the addiction is removed from balance.
